title: Smoking Bishop

Smoking Bishop is a type of mulled wine, punch or wassail. It was especially popular in Victorian England at Christmas time and it appears in Dickens' story "A Christmas Carol".

title: Caipirinha

Caipirinha (] ) is Brazil's national cocktail, made with cachaça (] ) (sugarcane hard liquor), sugar and lime. Cachaça, also known as "pinga", "caninha", or any one of a multitude of traditional names, is Brazil's most common distilled alcoholic beverage. Although both rum and cachaça are made from sugarcane-derived products, in cachaça the alcohol results from the fermentation of fresh sugarcane juice that is then distilled, while rum is usually made from refinery by-products such as molasses.
